create_solver: create a generic solver for non-symmetric games with configurable projection gradient and random initialization
init_solver_vars: initialize solver parameters with number of strategies per player and return initial strategy distributions
compute_solver_gradients: compute gradients for all solver parameters given current params and payoff matrices
run_euc_descent_step: run projected gradient descent on exploitability using Euclidean projection onto the simplex
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent on exploitability using softmax of log-learnt gradients
